﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: http v0.25 -> v1.1.1

## Context

Project `docker-adapter` (by artipie) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.artipie:http` from `v0.25` to `v1.1.1` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/pull/508

## Your Task

The source code is in `/docker-adapter`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

steps.message: The compilation errors show missing `org.cactoos.io` and `org.cactoos.text` packages. The `http` v1.1.1 upgrade apparently no longer provides cactoos as a transitive dependency. Let me read the affected files and understand what needs to be fixed:

Now I understand the issue. The code uses `org.cactoos.io.BytesOf` and `org.cactoos.text.HexOf` from the cactoos library, but the `http` v1.1.1 dependency no longer brings cactoos as a transitive dependency.

The fix is to add an explicit cactoos dependency to the pom.xml. Let me check what version would be appropriate:

steps.message:
The compilation failure has been fixed. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary

The issue was that `com.artipie:http` v1.1.1 no longer includes `cactoos` as a transitive dependency, causing compilation errors for `org.cactoos.io.BytesOf` and `org.cactoos.text.HexOf`.

### Files Modified

1. **`pom.xml`**: Added `javax.xml.bind:jaxb-api:2.3.1` dependency to provide `DatatypeConverter` for hex encoding (since `javax.xml.bind` was removed in Java 11+)

2. **`DigestFromContent.java`**: Replaced `new HexOf(new BytesOf(sha.digest())).asString()` with `DatatypeConverter.printHexBinary(sha.digest()).toLowerCase()`

3. **`DigestedFlowable.java`**: Same replacement as above

The `mvn compile` now succeeds.
